usage: tiers[N] lists moves with startup <= N frames, best first; use the tier equal to the opponent's frame disadvantage (clamped to 10..20). standing is for opponents who are standing, crouching drops high moves that whiff over a crouching opponent. whiff[N] is for punishing a whiffed move that leaves N frames of recovery before the opponent can act. Ranked by input difficulty (easy, medium for while-standing moves, hard for motion inputs), then launcher, then summed hit damage, then startup.
